study.question: Does a field-pair summary benefit when its temporal location follows the magnitude of target-conditioned content contributions, rather than treating every matching event equally?
study.hypothesis: The incumbent occupancy representation uses O=mu_uniform*S where S is the signed DIN-weighted pair content and mu_uniform is the unweighted mean of the temporal-bin rank basis on the exact pair support. This can locate a strongly activated recent contribution at the mean position of many weak earlier matches. Replacing only mu_uniform by mu_abs=sum(abs(stopgrad(w))*c)/sum(abs(stopgrad(w))) on that same support may better bind location to the evidence represented by S. Absolute weight means contribution magnitude, not positive preference. This is a provisional representation hypothesis, not an established mechanism.
study.proposed_difference: Inside _select_pair_rank_component only, construct detached positive magnitudes abs(w) on exact joint pair support. Divide by the pair maximum when positive, then divide the weighted rank sum by the positive mass; these two normalizations preserve the absolute-weight centroid while avoiding a signed denominator and an arbitrary epsilon threshold. All-zero magnitude falls back to the uniform centroid; empty support has zero centroid. Replace O=mu_uniform*S with O=mu_abs*S and retain signed S and its gradient. No gradient passes through centroid weights; this deliberately tests a content-conditioned summary without adding a second direct optimization path through local activation. Both centroids are computed in the candidate and optional uniform preflight configuration. Every other inherited path is retained.

topic.title: Transfer of compact-mean history aggregation to the strongest pair-rank-occupancy representation
topic.question: Under the frozen inputs and training protocol, does combining the committed g0 pair-rank-occupancy approach with g1 compact-mean aggregation exceed both frozen source bests, especially validation four-task macro ROC-AUC 0.831886841754755, at justified parameter and measured compute cost?
topic.hypothesis: The nearest available evidence is the two committed source summaries and the unsuccessful g1 hybrid/blend contrasts; implementations and external priority are unverified. Inherit only the committed source approaches after inspection in the implementation phase. Compact aggregation may preserve useful information on the newer g0 representation while reducing aggregation cost, but shared ancestry may make it redundant and the weaker buy result may transfer. Cross source-representation replacement with aggregation replacement, using both frozen source bests as utility controls and matched-capacity/compute controls for attribution. Predict a macro-AUC gain above 0.831886841754755 with measured acceptable cost; failure to beat the stronger source falsifies the proposed utility for that implementation. Track every task's AUC and Logloss, especially buy, without adding a per-task veto. Capacity, optimization and selection variation remain alternative explanations. Stage only controls, authorized repetition and assessment that fit the remaining 2328s; single-seed gains remain provisional and same-seed reproduction is not independent mechanism support. Freeze selection before any permitted held-out assessment.

study.question: Does the exact committed compact-mean residual improve the stronger g0 pair-rank-occupancy representation beyond macro AUC 0.831886841754755, and beyond an equal-active-capacity DIN-summary replacement, under the frozen protocol?
study.hypothesis: The g0 global DIN sum uses target-dependent signed unnormalized weights. A separately normalized uniform mean of the same valid history values may preserve global behavior composition suppressed by these weights, complementing pair occupancy and field/feedback summary tokens. The shared, zero-start low-rank residual may improve all-task ranking without an event/query retrieval stack. The source score gap alone does not establish this mechanism.
study.proposed_difference: Append the unmodified g1 compact residual after g0 source construction in a CPU RNG fork; add its update to the global DIN-sum portion of each tower input. All tasks receive the same residual summary/maps; this is not task-adaptive retrieval. Two controls replace its input by DIN at identical active capacity, and remove it from the g1 representation to complete a source-bundle-by-residual factorial with the frozen receipts.
